Title: As a property professional, I want to save and correct a listing draft, so that its address, price, availability and photos are accurate before publication.
Source: A01/A03; field validation is a proposed implementation constraint

Title: As a property professional, I want to sign off on my own draft before platform review, so that I retain control of the information I submit.
Source: A04; author sign-off differs from platform approval

Title: As a local sponsor, I want to preview an offer before it is reviewed and published, so that I can check its terms, dates, hours and image permission.
Source: B03/B04; sponsor preview is not evidence every role requested identical sign-off

Title: As a local sponsor, I want an offer to stop showing at its end time and be pausable early, so that residents do not see an unavailable offer.
Source: B05; UTC/exclusive boundary is proposed D-04 below

Title: As a resident, I want sponsored placements clearly labeled, so that I can distinguish paid content from platform information.
Source: B04; resident wording is an inference, not a resident interview

Title: As a property professional, I want inquiries relayed without publishing my private contact details, so that prospective residents can contact me without exposing unnecessary personal information.
Source: A08; delivery/retention and anti-abuse rules need confirmation

Title: As a reader, I want essential listing and offer information available in accessible text, so that I can understand it without relying only on an image.
Source: A07/B07; reader needs are simulated publisher guesses, not accessibility-user research

Title: As a property professional, I want to reconfirm that my listing is current, so that stale information can be corrected without unexpected silent expiry.
Source: A05; do not impose sponsor hard-expiry behavior on property listings

Title: As a property professional, I want a removal reason and a way to request review, so that I can understand and contest a moderation decision.
Source: A04; sponsor appeal preference remains unknown

Title: As a publisher, I want useful aggregate measures without resident-level tracking, so that I can assess content usefulness while minimizing personal-data collection.
